review_scope: Primary read the complete first-pass report and independently read full env.json, task.json, controls.json, generator, browser JavaScript, CSS, grader, verifier and solver.
decision: Keep baseline 3D, temporal No, reasoning/planning Yes and exploration/interface Yes. The actuator-to-foot geometry and three-contact support requirement make height/depth and safe ordered placement consequential. SETTLE advances a finite visible transition rather than requiring control of elapsed time. Active views resolve near/far pad relationships at the baseline.

rationale_clarifications.temporal: The hidden released marker can be satisfied by the visible raise-then-settle procedure; it is not itself evidence of a required remembered state.
rationale_clarifications.configuration_exceptions: Retain the reviewer's L1-L2 exploration No exceptions as source-based profile judgments, not experimentally established visibility thresholds. Lower clutter and larger tolerances alone would not establish a capability change; the proposed distinction additionally depends on the displayed grey-decoy legend, complete static pad drawing and simple low-variation route.

uncertainties: The baseline labels are decided. The exact L2/L3 boundary for when an orbit becomes necessary remains a source-review limitation; no all-seed screenshot visibility experiment was performed. Configuration exceptions are not independently calibrated.
